doc: metrics.patches: 7 latitudes x 8 longitudes = 56 gnomonic patches of 256x256 (half-angle 10 deg) sampled bilinearly from the float32 map (stored here as u8, converted u8 / 255 in float32), returned as float64 (the lerp weights are float64). Outputs: the integer lat and lon of each patch, and the patches sampled at the texels listed in params.stride_idx (a subset, to keep the case small: a port computes the whole patch and compares these texels). Full-resolution float64 texels (rows and columns 64..191, the central 128x128 crop) of patch 0 (latitude -55, longitude -180): the patch center is ON the antimeridian, so the crop straddles it and columns wrap through the last map column. Same 1e-9. Input convention: the u8 input(s) img are maps stored as bytes, and the function receives them as float32(u8) / float32(255) (`u8.astype(np.float32) / 255.0`: the division is done, and correctly rounded, in float32, as measure.load reads an 8-bit map), NOT as the raw bytes and NOT as a float64 quotient (a texel on a histogram edge or a threshold would move). params.u8_inputs lists them.

u8_inputs.img: float32(u8) / float32(255), the division in float32
